description: Delivered 16 April 1969; registered 6 June 1969 as CCCP-87694 to the Kyrgyz Civil Aviation Directorate at Osh; filmed in service in a scene of the 1976 Soviet feature "Бросок; или всё началось в субботу"; struck off 19 November 1987 on expiry of service life; erected in the Osh city park and used as a children's cinema; year_built from the delivery date as no separate build date is stated
